lines.text: The allotment for Joseph's descendants ran from the Jordan at Jericho into Bethel's hill country and west to the Sea.
Manasseh could not occupy the cities assigned in Issachar and Asher, and the stronger Israelites never drove out the Canaanites completely.
Joshua told the sons of Joseph to clear the forest, but they said the valley Canaanites had iron idols.
